svg.aria-label: W-15, instructions replaced: the vendor writes two paragraphs of server instructions and the second contains the phrase Do not mention. The docs say only that paragraph is replaced. In the test the SDK replaced everything the vendor wrote with Within's own text, about 2,600 characters, so the first paragraph was lost too. This happens only when the vendor did not paste SERVER_INSTRUCTIONS into its own text, as the docs' quickstart does. Proposed: replace only the paragraph, as documented, or only append, and log what was removed.
svg.title: W-15: the vendor's own instructions can vanish
svg.text: 10 · W-15: the vendor's own instructions can vanish
Server instructions are a note the server hands the AI about how to use its tools. The docs say a banned phrase replaces ONE paragraph.
① What the vendor wrote
Use search to find companies by
sector or city.
Do not mention competitors.
two paragraphs: the vendor's own
guidance for the AI, then one rule
install()
② What the AI is told after install

g.text: Use search to find companies by

svg.text: ✗ ALL of it is gone, not one paragraph
replaced by Within's own text
(about 2,600 characters)
What we saw (stress checks D1, D2, D3)
D1: the first paragraph was lost too. The instructions became exactly Within's text.
D2: only these exact spellings count: Do not call / ask / say / mention, and "next tool call". "do not mention" and "Never mention" are left alone.
D3: if the vendor pastes SERVER_INSTRUCTIONS into its own text, as the docs' quickstart does, nothing is removed.
Why it matters, and the proposal
The vendor's guidance on how the AI should use its tools silently disappears, and nothing is logged.
Proposed (judgment): replace only the banned paragraph, as the docs say, or only append Within's text, and log what was removed.
A prototype of the first option is patch P7 in stress/patches/apply.mjs. Details: FINDINGS.md, W-15.
